race.title: BAR 1 Betting 'Acca Boost' Apprentice Handicap
race.verdict: SOARING SUN hasn't been at his best on turf since going in over C&D early in the year and is taken to bounce back in style now returned to his favoured polytrack. Baila Conmigo can also boast C&D-winning form and is next on the list ahead of Autocrat and Pralognan . SOARING SUN (IRE) BAILA CONMIGO (IRE) AUTOCRAT (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Baila Conmigo (4/1), Pralognan (5/1), Storm Eric (5/1), Justenzia (6/1), Autocrat (6/1), Soaring Sun (8/1), Doctor Grace (12/1), Showyoutheropes (12/1), Palmezzano (14/1), Among The Pines (14/1), My Vonnie (50/1)
